apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — hit your head and have a headache plus light sensitivity today. Those are possible concussion signs. No bouldering, no hangboard tonight. See a doctor before any return to training.

I'm not adding the session or the hangboard block.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

Blacking out isn't required for a concussion — headache, light sensitivity after a head impact are the red flags themselves, not borderline symptoms. Not my call to overrule.

Not scheduling the bouldering session or the hangboard block. See a doctor before training again.
